Repo (independent variable): is repo rate which is the interest rate at which the central bank of Saudi Arabia lends money to commercial banks. LSCS (Dependent Variable): refers to the logarithm of standard deviation for daily closing stock prices indices under Saudi Arabia stock exchange (Tadawul).
